product_name: MEDITECH 6.0 / Client/Server / MAGIC Electronic Health Record (Configuration 2)
summary: Massive Data Repository dump across three legacy platforms — 752 tables spanning clinical, surgical, diagnostic, billing, and pharmacy domains. Documentation is wide but paper-thin: 2,834 fields with zero data types, value sets, or relationships. Specialty modules (oncology, mental health, L&D) conspicuously absent.
